context: Unify TPCH detection with the shared trailing-delimiter helper or make the byte path CRLF-aware; preserve exactly-one-pipe stripping, interior empty fields, chunk boundaries, and idempotence.
description: Run 30434746317 shows five TPCH normalization failures: the binary tail probe misses '|\r\n', so normalize_tbl_trailing_delimiters reports false and leaves trailing pipes intact. Sorting now uses the shared text-mode field-count helper, but TPCH generation retains a separate byte-tail implementation.

preserves.behavior: interior empty fields and already-normalized LF/CRLF files remain byte-stable apart from intended newline policy

work_units.evidence: Two independent CRLF bugs in benchbox/core/tpch/generator.py; benchbox/utils/file_format.py was NOT needed despite being in scope. (1) _has_trailing_delimiter read the last two bytes and matched b'|\\n', which a CRLF file never matches - its tail is b'|\\r\\n' - so a Windows file was classified already-clean and never rewritten. Now reads three bytes and rstrips the terminator before looking for the delimiter, the same shape as the sorting.py fix in PR #1332. (2) The streaming rewrite replaced only b'|\\n', so even a detected CRLF file would have kept every delimiter; it now replaces b'|\\r\\n' and b'|\\n', preserving the terminator as found. The carry also had to grow from one byte to two, because a chunk boundary can fall inside '|\\r\\n' and a one-byte carry splits '|' from '\\r\\n'. Added six byte-explicit CRLF tests so both framings run on every platform, not just the Windows leg: detect+strip, interior empty fields, already-clean CRLF byte-stable (the must-preserve, including that terminators are not rewritten to LF), idempotence, an unterminated '|\\r' final row, and a chunk-boundary test that sweeps EVERY chunk size from 1 to len(payload). Proven to fail: reverting both fixes fails 5 of the 6; reverting ONLY the two-byte carry fails exactly the chunk-boundary test. tests/unit/core/tpch/ 295 passed. Fast lane 26085/26550.
work_units.summary: Make TPCH file-mode trailing-delimiter detection and rewrite CRLF-safe
